name: Model Extraction & Inversion
description: Repeated, structured querying of a model to clone its functionality, recover training-data membership, or invert it into the underlying examples.
differs: Targets the model as intellectual property or as a data store; contrast with Sensitive Data Disclosure (T5.002), which leaks data the system was handling.
